title: Accumulating Pruning Constraints: New Exact Polynomial-Space Algorithms for Max 2-SAT
abstract: arXiv:2610.39992v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present deterministic polynomial-space algorithms that solve Max 2-SAT on $n$ variables exactly in time $\Ostar(2^{(1-\gamma)n})$, for a fixed $\gamma>0$, on several classes of instances whose clause density may grow with $n$. Our main tool extends the classic DPLL branching algorithm. When the search gives a variable its less promising value, comparing the two values of the variable yields a pruning constraint that is satisfied by some optimal assignment. Accumulating these constraints along each branch prunes all but an exponentially small fraction of the assignments. The classes are formulas with many biased variables, semirandom 2-CNF formulas, and Max-Cut on regular expander graphs and on graphs generated by a stochastic block model. translated_title: 累积剪枝约束：Max 2-SAT 的新型精确多项式空间算法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了确定性多项式空间算法，对于若干子句密度可能随 n 增长的实例类，能够在时间 O*(2^{(1-γ)n})（其中 γ>0 为固定常数）内精确求解 n 个变量的 Max 2-SAT 问题。我们的主要工具是对经典 DPLL 分支算法的扩展。当搜索过程为变量赋予其较不利取值时，通过比较该变量的两个取值可以产生一个剪枝约束，该约束会被某个最优赋值所满足。沿每个分支累积这些约束能够剪掉除指数级小部分之外的所有赋值。所涉及的实例类包括含有大量偏置变量的公式、半随机 2-CNF 公式，以及正则扩张图和由随机块模型生成的图上的 Max-Cut 问题。在半随机公式中，可能共享子句的变量对是任意的，而这些变量对上的子句是随机生成的。对于半随机公式和块模型图，这些算法……
tldr: 本文通过在 DPLL 分支搜索中累积剪枝约束，实现了多项式空间下时间复杂度为 O*(2^{(1-γ)n}) 的 Max 2-SAT 精确算法，并适用于子句密度可随问题规模增长的多种实例类。
en_tdlr: By accumulating pruning constraints along DPLL branching, this paper achieves exact polynomial-space algorithms for Max 2-SAT running in time O*(2^{(1-γ)n}) on several instance classes whose clause density may grow with n.
